description.en: Opens the dialogue/message window with a given message ID, with optional layout arguments (centering, which screen/window to draw on, and an optional speaking character + facing direction for a bust-up).
ID of the message text to display.
Whether to draw the message window frame.
Optional speaking character handle/index for a bust-up.
Optional; whether the speaking character's bust-up faces right.
True once the message has finished being dismissed.
